description: MIDI clock slave (mu-on): external clock at 120 BPM runs from t=0 with +/-24 samples of jitter per pulse and sends Start at 0.5 s (Messages = both). The own Play is on, but the clock owns play, so nothing sounds until the Start; after it the pattern plays from bar 1. Guards the clock path end to end (Start edge, pulse-counted beat, resolver). Rendered in 64-sample blocks: the continuous beat must not stumble at block edges (a gate or step crossed twice).

assertions.name: silent_until_start
assertions.comment: clock pulses while stopped must not start the pattern
